svg.title: Jianma — step 3 editable group colour drawing
svg.desc: 45 independent leaf groups. Left/right are the character’s own directions. No background, embedded raster, garment layer, shading or animation. Hidden body and hair bases are completed.

g.title: Character right: screen left. Hidden base continues behind shoulder and torso.
Character left: screen right. Full hidden hair base is retained.
The arch is a continuous narrow band; its large inner opening is transparent.
Branch cutout retains the small exterior curls and internal negative spaces.
The bead-chain gaps remain real transparency; the ribbon is one solid editable contour.
Hidden knee overlap runs to y=1000; no gap between thigh and calf.
Rounded upper thigh continues beneath pelvis. The visible lower boundary is the knee split.
Anatomical construction block: completes the hips under the temporary suit. No garment styling.
Temporary leotard removed. Chest, abdomen and waist are a continuous plain body block without garment outlines.
All finger silhouettes, tips and the thumb–index opening are retained.
Complete ear base includes the helix behind the bangs and the narrow visible inner lobe.
Complete ear base includes the helix behind the bangs and the narrow visible inner lobe.
Full forehead base retained behind the hair and forehead jewellery.
Main front lock plus its two thin returning wisps; the outer curl keeps the black opening.
The single leaf combines the contiguous lotus petals, central faceted plaque and lower silver flourishes.
The top hanging loop is open. Gem tips follow y=209, 232 and 244 from the reference.
Pearls, faceted pendant and toe connector traced as one flat marker; foot skin stays visible through the ankle opening.
